narration: "And when the dockhand lay beaten at his feet," Scheherazade paused, "what did Sinbad do, O King?"

options.label: He spared him, and helped him to his feet.
He took the man's purse and walked on.
He struck him once more, to be sure.

narration: "The charmer begged for her serpent's life," said Scheherazade. "What did Sinbad say to her, O King?"

options.label: He let the serpent go free.
He sold it to a passing merchant.
He killed it before her eyes.

narration: "Alhamdulillah [praise be to God]," Scheherazade said, "the chest-with-teeth stilled at last. What did Sinbad do with its hoard, O King?"

options.label: He gave half to the dockworkers it had cheated.
He kept every coin for himself.
He burned it all, cursing its evil.
